summary: First full-stack test of HIBI NOMI MVP. Backend: 25/25 pytest cases pass across auth (register/login/me/logout/forgot/reset), profile + target calc, intake CRUD, /day aggregation (progress > 100% capped remaining=0), weekly + monthly reports (incl. empty state), reminders GET/PUT with validation + pause/resume, CSV export, and data isolation across 2 users. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): login screen renders with branded blue theme, register flow succeeds, Home shows ring with target/progress/remaining, quick-add +250 and custom +350 both increment correctly (0 → 250 → 600 ml, progress 0% → 12%), tab navigation to Reports/Reminders/Profile all work and bind to backend data (weekly avg = 86 ml after 600 ml logged, monthly label 'October 2026', profile displays user name + Auto target). Reminders screen shows master toggle, interval chips, active window, and pause chips. No deprecated expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch packages. No React Native red-screen errors. Harmless web warnings only: 'shadow* props deprecated' and 'expo-notifications push token listener not supported on web' (expected on web preview per spec).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns 'shadow*' style props are deprecated — use 'boxShadow'. This is a react-native-web migration note and does not affect native builds, but worth fixing in shared StyleSheet usage. Reference: console output on load of /
Console warns 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely from a dependency; low priority. Reference: console output on load of /

action_items: Optional: migrate any shadow* style usages to boxShadow for react-native-web cleanliness (cosmetic, not blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~750-line file. Still readable but approaching the 700-line soft limit; consider splitting into routers (auth/profile/intakes/reports/reminders/export) when adding more features.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is permissive. Fine for preview/dev; tighten for production.
forgot_password returns the reset_token in the API response (by design per spec for in-app flow). Flag for production: ensure this is only used for the dev/preview UX and not exposed in prod.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of smoke flows (signup, home ring, quick-add, custom-add, tab nav, reports, reminders, profile)

seed_data_creation: Each pytest run registers 3 temp users (TEST_* prefix). UI test registers 1 temp user. No cleanup implemented, but data is namespaced per user and does not affect existing demo@hibinomi.app account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Run serially: `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://hibi-nomi.preview.emergentagent.com pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -n 0`. pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope but module-scoped user fixtures cross workers, so pass `-n 0` to force serial. Use testIDs listed in /app/frontend/app/**/*.tsx for selectors — all critical interactive elements are tagged. Google OAuth cannot be automated; use email/password only. demo@hibinomi.app / water123 remains valid.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
